criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, living or historical.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A company, institution, group, or governmental body.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural landform or body of water.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A human habitation, such as a village, town, city, or administrative division.

categories.name: Organism
categories.definition: A living being, including plants, animals, fungi, or other biological classifications.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A man-made structure, typically fixed and enclosed.

categories.name: Vehicle Model
categories.definition: A specific design or type of vehicle, rather than an individual unit.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written work, including novels, biographies, anthologies, or graphic novels.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A recorded music release, including studio albums, EPs, or compilations.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including feature films, documentaries, or mini-series.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A periodical, such as a journal, magazine, newspaper, or comic strip.

categories.name: Site
categories.definition: A specific location of historical, cultural, or engineering significance that is not a settlement or natural feature.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: An artistic or intellectual work that is not a book, album, or film, such as a play or recorded performance.

categories.name: Product or Service
categories.definition: A commercial offering or specific product.
